sources.title-crypt.png: Use case: stylized-concept. ORIGINAL hand-painted dark fantasy RPG main menu BACKGROUND, wide 1920x1080, refined painterly realism, subtle brush texture, no pixel art, no lettering, no logo, no symbols from existing franchises, no characters. View looking directly into a vast ancient underground stone crypt through a deep Gothic arch. Layered worn limestone vaults recede toward a small remote dark doorway. Richly carved but weathered stone pillars frame the far LEFT and RIGHT edges; restrained carved geometric funerary ornament, dark forged-iron railings, scattered worn stone, damp reflective floor. Two small iron braziers with warm amber coals positioned toward the lower left and lower right, gentle faint smoke rising. Muted cool charcoal, grey sage stone and warm brass/ember light; readable dimensional edges and convincing broad light/shadow planes. Quiet monumental, ominous, atmospheric without gore. Composition MUST leave the central 55% of the image visually calm and darker for menu text and buttons, especially upper center behind a separate title and lower center between y=500 and y=920. Both side regions have detailed warmly illuminated stone; the center has soft depth and a faint cold distant shaft of light. Foreground in shadow; mild haze between arches. The central composition must still work when cropped to portrait aspect ratio. No bright white hotspot behind text. High quality painted game concept illustration. Original design, no Diablo assets or imitation of a specific existing scene.
sources.title-wordmark.png: Use case: logo-brand. Original dark fantasy video game wordmark with exactly the text "GRIMHOLLOW" spelled G R I M H O L L O W, all ten letters on ONE horizontal line. TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA background. Wide horizontal image 2048x512. Elegant monumental engraved serif capitals, readable strong stems and fine wedge serifs, subtly weathered ivory metal with old champagne-gold bevels, restrained shadow inside engraved edges, refined painterly realism, NOT pixel art. Lettering evenly spaced and centered with generous transparent margins. No second line, no tagline, no symbols, no skulls, no ornament outside the letters, no underline, no frame, no flames, no oversized first letter. All letters same cap height. High readability when downsampled. No imitation of the logo or font of any existing game. Only the word GRIMHOLLOW, no extra text. Crisp alpha around letters; no black rectangle or checkerboard.
sources.title-mist.png: Use case: stylized-concept. A single isolated very soft horizontal ribbon of drifting cool grey-blue crypt mist for compositing over a dark fantasy game menu. True TRANSPARENT RGBA image, 1536x512 wide. Low delicate smoky wisps and turbulent curling filaments, brightest in the lower middle, mostly transparent, completely fading to ZERO alpha on all four edges, generous empty transparent border. Subtle hand-painted natural volumetric fog, no hard outlines, no scene, no objects, no ground, no colored backdrop, no text or checkerboard. Uneven wisps with broad transparent gaps, soft detailed strands. Entire mist contained in frame; real alpha, not black background. Intended to be animated slowly across a painted crypt foreground.
